card.name: Syllable breaks in pronunciation guides
card.fires_on: Separators and letters inside syllable-by-syllable spellings of medical words, such as dots, hyphens and respelled sounds, in dictionary entries and pronunciation guides.

modes.label: Dotted syllable splits
modes.description: The dot or slash between syllables in a dictionary-style hyphenation of a long medical term.

modes.label: Respelled pronunciation
modes.description: Letters or hyphens inside a phonetic respelling in capitals or lowercase, often in parentheses.

card.writes: It suppresses sound-like pieces such as APA and aha, so it pushes against continuing with a new syllable-like piece.
card.plain: It fires when a medical word is being spelled out syllable by syllable to show how to say it.
